turns.reply:
I changed `Live.stop()` in `rich/live.py` so a transient `Live` with an empty renderable no longer leaves a stray blank line behind. I did not confirm this matches the exact behaviour in the hidden tests for issue #3796.

The newline hypothesis from the earlier notes was wrong. The real cause is that `stop()` always calls `console.line()` on a terminal, and when the render has zero height, the transient restore sequence moves the cursor up zero rows, so that newline stays on screen. The patch skips that newline only when the render is transient and empty. Non-transient output is unchanged. The existing `tests/test_live.py` passes (10 tests), and a manual check shows the transient empty case now ends with the cursor back at column 0 and no leftover blank line.
